findings.summary: Source-download rows render a permanently hidden copy of browse work actions.
findings.consequence: Every source-download work row still instantiates the browse action list, including hidden anchors and NuxtLink components, even though this workspace exposes selection and source-format download controls instead of row action disclosure. This preserves unreachable URL-handling template code and can drift from the operable browse-row implementation.
findings.evidence: The owned block begins with v-show="false" at line 358 and renders item.actions through the hidden data-library-work-actions list. LibraryBrowseResults.vue exposes the same action-list responsibility behind an aria-controls/aria-expanded work-title button, while this source-download template has no control that can reveal the block.
findings.recommendation: Delete the hidden data-library-work-actions block from the source-download template and then remove workActionsId and canonicalNuxtHref from this component if they have no remaining consumers. Keep action disclosure in LibraryBrowseResults.vue, where it is operable.
